components.css: .ds-appearance {padding:12px; font-family:"IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif; color:var(--ink, #2d2c25);} .ds-appearance-trigger {display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:10px; min-height:44px; min-width:44px; border:1px solid var(--line, #b6ad96); border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:inherit; font:12px "IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif; cursor:pointer;} .ds-appearance-trigger:hover {background:var(--theme-field, #f7f1e3);} .ds-appearance-popup {width:310px; max-width:calc(100vw - 48px); padding:20px; margin-top:8px; background:var(--theme-field, #f7f1e3); border-radius:3px; box-shadow:0 6px 24px #292b2533;} .ds-appearance-popup h2 {margin:0; font:500 18px "IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif;} .ds-appearance-popup p {font-size:13px; color:var(--muted, #625e50); margin:6px 0 18px; line-height:1.5;} .ds-appearance-popup fieldset {border:0; padding:0; margin:0;} .ds-appearance-popup legend {font-size:12px; color:var(--muted, #625e50); margin-bottom:6px;} .ds-appearance-popup label {display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:62px; padding:10px 0; cursor:pointer;} .ds-appearance-popup label + label {border-top:1px solid var(--line, #b6ad96);} .ds-appearance-popup input {width:18px; height:18px; margin:0; accent-color:var(--green, #484b35);} .ds-appearance-popup strong {display:block; font-size:13px; font-weight:500;} .ds-appearance-popup small {display:block; font-size:11px; margin-top:4px; color:var(--muted, #625e50);} .ds-appearance-trigger:focus-visible, .ds-appearance-popup input:focus-visible {outline:3px solid #b9802c; outline-offset:4px;}

narrative.overview:
The production workbench offers two user-approved document themes: **Service Manual** and **Intercept Form**. Both retain the original responsive layout, control placement, and simulation behavior. `PRODUCT.md` owns product scope; `src/themes.css` and `src/appearance.css` implement this visual system over the shared component styles.

Service Manual is the default: olive accents, aged paper, condensed headings, and a charcoal instrument. Intercept Form uses warmer paper, oxblood accents, and typewriter headings. Compact sans-serif explanations and amber output lamps keep the machine readable in either appearance.
dos: **Do** extend both document themes through their shared tokens and preserve the original workbench layout and distinct signal states.
**Do** use monospaced type for machine values and readable prose for explanations.
**Do** preserve visible labels, focus outlines, validation text, and candidate uncertainty.
**Do** check the dense keyboard and configuration at mobile widths.
donts: **Don't** imply that a matching candidate is a uniquely recovered key or that this is a physically faithful British Bombe.
**Don't** reintroduce discarded prototype themes or prototype controls into the production Appearance menu.
